title: VoiceOS App Store — voice-native assistant + a store of installable voice workflows
gap: The gap it claims — assistants that execute — is real but sits on land the platform owners hold: deep cross-app control belongs to Apple and Google at the OS level.

zh.gap: 它宣称的缺口——「会执行的助手」——是真的，但地皮在平台手里：深度跨 App 控制是 Apple／Google 的 OS 级领地。
zh.pain: 它指向的痛真实且古老：十年的语音助手听得见你，却什么都干不了。
zh.kill: 第三方「语音 OS」在 iOS/Android 上先天残疾；这个同族的坟场里已经躺着两台硬件（Rabbit R1、Humane）和每一波 agent 助手。商店角度＝快捷指令画廊换皮。
zh.move: 我们无从下手——留档当注意力标记：「终于会动手的助手」这个承诺至今仍有 166 个赞的热度。

pain: The pain it points at is real and ancient: a decade of assistants that hear you but can't actually do anything.
kill: Third-party 'voice OS' is structurally hamstrung on iOS/Android, and the family graveyard already holds two hardware flameouts (Rabbit R1, Humane) plus every agent-assistant wave since. The store angle is Shortcuts-gallery redux.
move: None for us — archived as the attention marker for how hot the 'assistant that finally acts' promise still runs (166 likes on a launch tweet).
